takenRequests.title: Walking week · 3 days
takenRequests.description: Take a comfortable walk for at least five minutes on 3 different days. Keep the practice manageable and record each session.

takenRequests.description: Use twenty minutes of active recall on earlier material. Check errors and schedule another review.
